notes: 22-31R picks. Gutter overlap with 22-31L (R x ~ L x - 5555, R y ~ L y - 34): Clara/Northside, Clara/Orange, Felton/Orange, Orange/Lehman Road picked on both. Selim Avenue crossings left from 22-31L picked here: Westwood (north end), Esmonde, Northside, Lane, Lionel (south end). Selim's centre drifts from x~652 at Westwood to ~607 at Lane/Lionel. Westwood is ~37 ft wide here (centre y~1404 west of Mohawk) and turns ENE at Mohawk to merge with Harrison. Harrison Avenue: the streetcar road from the NW crossing Queen City is unlabelled on this half and is named Harrison (it is the branch that is not Westwood at the fork). East of the creek two roads are both printed HARRISON AVE: the upper (old) road with the water pipe and sewer, recorded as Harrison Avenue (matches 22-13L), and the lower viaduct road (printed VIADUCT on its east part), recorded as Harrison Avenue Viaduct; its crossings of Willow and Garrard are probably grade-separated (22-13L left the viaduct out). Names printed without suffix and kept as printed: Pinetree, Lawnway, Hiawatha, Canton. Italic stub labels east of Garrard: BANKS (recorded as Bank Street to match 22-10L/22-13L), DAYTON, EXETER, POPLAR, DUCK; the unlabelled stub at y~4910 is York Street by position against 22-10L. Wallace, Detroit, Evans, State named as on 22-29R. Unnamed (?): the six streets printed only STREET in the Grotenkemper/Ernst subdivisions (see each note); the 60 ft ENE street printed STREET from the Hiawatha junction to Harrison (Meader and Ernst end on it); the narrow diagonal way printed LANE between Tait and Ashley (continues south as Canton). Prospect (printed STREET near Hiawatha, PROSPECT further south) runs S then SSW and continues as Jean Street (JEAN ... STREET) to Lehman Road; Shelby Street continues the line SSW from Lehman Road to Dodson. Wallace jogs ~85 px at Liberty (north part printed WALLACE, south part unlabelled stub). Liberty starts at State (no Liberty west of State, consistent with 22-29R). Not streets: GERRARD & COOPER'S SUB, EDWARD DODSON'S EST., CHAS. LEHMAN'S and JEAN'S SUBDIV'N labels; the thin diagonal railroad crossing the Ernst subdivision. No bracketed old names seen.
